entries.197f0bb6217c8c1c: This is a reportable segment that provides various services, mainly on the internet, with the aim of supporting corporate promotion. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥5,167 million. The segment is carried out by Buranjisuta Co., Ltd., Buranjisuta Ēru Co., Ltd., Buranjisuta Media Co., Ltd., Buranjisuta Solution Co., Ltd., Boshe Ji Gufen Youxian Gongsi, CrowdLab Co., Ltd., and others.
entries.3168e725aae1f847: This is a service in which the latest energy-saving equipment is provided, with zero initial investment including installation costs, to customers that operate stores and facilities, and the Group receives usage fee income, including interest, in installments or as a lump sum. User acquisition operations are also included in this business. Amounts are not disclosed separately.
entries.34d8a3486dcedac7: This is the provision of "Akuseru Japan," a corporate promotion support project that offers a promotion tool, with no initial fee and a fixed monthly fee, allowing use of photos and videos of well-known celebrities, and a venue where executives can learn and network (Buranjisuta Ēru Co., Ltd., etc.). Amounts are not disclosed separately.
entries.3caef6a1ccde439e: This business provides the electricity supply service "Nekushīzu Denryoku." Under a business alliance agreement with Ekorogu Co., Ltd., NEXYZ. Fashiritīzu Co., Ltd. acts as an agent in providing "Nekushīzu Denryoku," a service named after itself, and earns a sales commission upon acquiring a contract and an ongoing commission associated with continued use. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥31 million.
entries.4231778656e81fd7: Provision of "Nekushīzu ZERO" and user acquisition operations
entries.851e06482edc7cb6: This is the sale of energy-saving equipment, including commercial LED lighting, air conditioners, refrigerators, kitchen equipment, plumbing equipment, agricultural equipment and industrial equipment. Amounts are not disclosed separately.
entries.92257aad8600c4d6: A business holding company that offers a service enabling the introduction of energy-saving equipment with zero initial investment, along with digital magazines and corporate promotion support.
entries.c2648b00a328ae6d: Companies across a wide range of industries that operate stores and facilities
entries.c47dbc1824fe1776: This business carries out advertising placements in electronic magazines such as "Tabiiro" and contract production of electronic magazines (Buranjisuta Media Co., Ltd.). It also produces tie-up magazines with local governments. Amounts are not disclosed separately.
